title.narrative: Sustainable Landscape Investment Partnership in Indonesia (KIBAR)

description.narrative: UK FCDO is developing a new major program in Indonesia, tentatively named INAFOR - Investment in Forest and Nature (now INAFOLU - to match with the Indonesia's Ministry of Environment and Forestry agenda of FOLU Net Sink 2030). The program size will be around GBP 40 million for the first 4-5 years, with most of the budget to be likely channeled through the Indonesian Environmental Fund (BPDLH). Based on discussion with UK FCDO on July 11, 2022, GGGI had then developed a "Think Peace" at FCDO’s request. After back and fort discussion, we then submitted a Think Piece/Concept Note in January 2023.In May 2023, we were contacted by FCDO saying that they now have completed a Business Case approval in London for this project and therefore would like to proceed with GGGI receiving the grant for this purpose. They were asking us to slightly revise the Concept Note to focus on investment component and less with policy and planning.For this, UK FCDO has about GBP 7.5 million to be spent for this fiscal year (1 April 2023 – 31 March 2024) and would provide similar amounts for the next 3 years (i.e. a total of £30 million) toward the project for which we have developed a CN. Note that most (2/3rd) of the FCDO funding for this is labelled as ‘Capital Spending’, i.e., it must be spent as investment – on-the-ground; 1/3rd can be used for TA.In the CN, GGGI mentioned to collaborate with Wildlife Society Conservation (WCS), as per FCDO suggestion at earliest years of this project development, in which they were receiving some funding in the past from UK FCDO to do project in Aceh and North Sulawesi provinces. While GGGI can propose activities at the ground level in Kalimantan, WCS was indicated to do work in Aceh and North Sulawesi.
